stock.description: Wuxi Sunlit Science and Technology Company Limited offers a comprehensive suite of services to the steel wire product manufacturing sector across the People's Republic of China. Its core activities encompass the entire lifecycle of specialized production lines, from initial research and development and design to manufacturing, equipment supply, installation, testing, repair, and ongoing maintenance. The company's extensive product range includes various production lines for specific applications, such as brass electroplating wire, bead wire, pre-treatment processes, inter-medium heat treatment, and both hot dip and electro galvanizing. Beyond these complete systems, Wuxi Sunlit also provides individual components and machinery. This includes gas furnaces, water quenching baths, lead baths designed for heat treatment, advanced diffusion induction heating systems, take-up and pay-off mechanisms, and acid mist scrubbers. Furthermore, it supplies specialized equipment like wire bunching, wire drawing, wrapping, and die repair machines. In addition to its primary manufacturing focus, Wuxi Sunlit is also involved in the trading of machinery products. The company actively participates in software development and the commercialization of software patent rights. The products developed by Wuxi Sunlit find broad application across numerous industrial sectors, contributing to the production of items such as radial tire steel cords, bead wires, cutting wires, hose wires, precision wire ropes, and a wide array of other steel wire derivatives. Founded in 2006, the company is headquartered in Wuxi, located in the People's Republic of China.
